product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Suspended Wire Ceiling Mount for Window-Shopping – Fits 43"–65" TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Suspended Wire Ceiling Mount for Window-Shopping is designed for high visibility, storefront and window-facing displays where clean aesthetics and minimal structure are essential.
